title: Frog holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q60 45 55 55' stroke='#E8E8E8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#FF6B8A' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='17' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='60,35 62,38 64,35' fill='#C1123A'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#C1123A'/>
  
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#3CB043'/>
  
  <!-- frog head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='54' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#4CD964'/>
  
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='8' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='42' r='8' fill='#4CD964'/>
  
  <!-- eyes white -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='6' fill='#F0FFF0'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='42' r='6' fill='#F0FFF0'/>
  
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='3' fill='#1A3A1A'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='42' r='3' fill='#1A3A1A'/>
  
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M32 60 Q40 68 48 60' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='1' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='52' r='1' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='76' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#B8F0B8'/>
  
  <!-- left arm reaching to string -->
  <path d='M55 62 Q58 56 60 52' stroke='#3CB043' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hand/fingers -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='3' fill='#4CD964'/>
  
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M22 68 Q16 72 14 78' stroke='#3CB043' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='78' r='3' fill='#4CD964'/>
  
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='87' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3CB043'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='87' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3CB043'/>
  <!-- toes -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='88' r='2' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='89' r='2' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='88' r='2' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='88' r='2' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='89' r='2' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='88' r='2' fill='#4CD964'/>
  
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#2E8B2E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='74' r='2' fill='#2E8B2E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='80' r='1.8' fill='#2E8B2E' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
